title: 52-byte record default initialization
summary: Recovered VA 0x568200 as a member initializer returning this. Writes all thirteen dwords: -1.0 at +0, zero at +4 through +24, all bits set at +28, zero at +32, and four 1.0 values at +36 through +48. No calls, global accesses or conditional paths.
test_description: Direct GCC i386 thiscall oracle comparisons on zero, all-ones and 256 patterned initial buffers; verify returned identity, all 52 output bytes against explicit expected words, 16-byte guards on both sides, repeated initialization and unchanged MXCSR under all four rounding modes.
known_limits: Gameplay field meanings and original source type names are unresolved; offset names are used. Float types at +36 through +48 reflect immediate IEEE encodings rather than recovered debug types.
Requires a valid writable record; invalid pointer fault behavior is not exercised. Concurrent access and partial-fault store ordering are not modeled.
Behavioral recovery only; no matching-byte claim.
